messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 10(8)

Article 10 Obligations of manufacturers of machinery and related products. 8. Manufacturers shall ensure that the machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A or, alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use and the information set out in Annex III. Digital EU declarations of conformity shall be made accessible online for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product and in any event for at least 10 years after the placing on the market or the putting into service of the machinery or related product.

response.text:
Manufacturers | shall ensure | machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A | alternatively, see the internet-address option | "Manufacturers shall ensure that the machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A"
Manufacturers | shall provide | internet address or machine-readable code where the EU declaration of conformity can be accessed, in the instructions for use | as an alternative to accompanying the declaration | "alternatively, manufacturers shall provide the internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use"
Manufacturers | shall provide | information set out in Annex III | "" | "and the information set out in Annex III"
Digital EU declarations of conformity | shall be made accessible online | for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product | "" | "Digital EU declarations of conformity shall be made accessible online for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product"
Digital EU declarations of conformity | shall be made accessible online | for at least 10 years after placing on the market or putting into service of the machinery or related product | applies in any event, as a minimum period | "and in any event for at least 10 years after the placing on the market or the putting into service of the machinery or related product"
